description: This file contains internal data structures, type definitions, function prototypes, and constants related to OpenSSL's EVP (Envelope) cryptographic API, including key management, encoding/decoding, and algorithm control functions.

classes.name: evp_pkey_asn1_method_st
classes.description: Structure defining ASN.1 method operations for public key types.

classes.name: evp_pkey_st
classes.description: Structure representing a public/private key with reference counting and associated method table.

classes.name: evp_pkey_ctx_st
classes.description: Context structure for key operations, including method, engine, key, peer key, and operation type.

classes.name: evp_pkey_method_st
classes.description: Structure defining function pointers for key operations such as sign, verify, encrypt, decrypt, derive, and control.

classes.name: ED25519_KEY
classes.description: Structure representing an Ed25519 key with private seed and public key components.

classes.name: X25519_KEY
classes.description: Structure representing a X25519 key with public and private components.

methods.name: EVP_PKEY_CTX_ctrl
methods.description: Performs control operations on a key context, such as setting parameters.
